tests.name: distinct direct source kinds
tests.script:
module AtomicDistinctDirectKinds
on Start {
  let vNothing be missing
  let vBoolean be true
  let vInteger be 10
  let vFloat be 10.5
  let vPercentage be 25%
  let vText be 'abba'
  let vTag be :abba
  let vVector be :vector(1, 2, 1)
  let vPoint be :point(1, 2, 1)
  let vList be [3, 1, 3, 2, 1]
  let vMap be [b: 2, a: 1, c: 2]
  let vDice as :dice be [6, 5, 5, 3, 3]
  let vRange as :range be from 1 to 3
  emit Done(nothingValue: vNothing[:distinct], booleanValue: vBoolean[:distinct], integerValue: vInteger[:distinct], floatValue: vFloat[:distinct], percentageValue: vPercentage[:distinct], textValue: vText[:distinct], tagValue: vTag[:distinct], vectorValue: vVector[:distinct], pointValue: vPoint[:distinct], listValue: vList[:distinct], mapValue: vMap[:distinct], diceValue: vDice[:distinct], rangeValue: vRange[:distinct])
}

tests.name: distinct by direct source kinds
tests.script:
module AtomicDistinctByDirectKinds
on Start {
  let units be [[name: 'Knight', faction: :melee, hp: 10], [name: 'Rook', faction: :melee, hp: 8], [name: 'Archer', faction: :ranged, hp: 6]]
  let values be [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  let emptyList be []
  let dice as :dice be [6, 5, 5, 3]
  let range as :range be from 1 to 3
  let map be [a: 1, b: 2]
  let byFaction be units[:distinct by unit => unit.faction]
  let byParity be values[:distinct by value => value mod 2]
  let byEmpty be emptyList[:distinct by item => item]
  emit Done(factionLen: :len byFaction, factionFirst: byFaction[1].name, factionSecond: byFaction[2].name, parityLen: :len byParity, parityFirst: byParity[1], paritySecond: byParity[2], emptyLen: :len byEmpty, diceValue: dice[:distinct by value => value], rangeValue: range[:distinct by value => value], mapValue: map[:distinct by value => value], integerValue: 10[:distinct by value => value], textValue: 'abba'[:distinct by value => value])
}

tests.name: distinct and distinct by transformed streams
tests.script:
module AtomicDistinctStreams
on Start {
  let units be [[name: 'Knight', faction: :melee, hp: 10], [name: 'Rook', faction: :melee, hp: 8], [name: 'Archer', faction: :ranged, hp: 6]]
  let dice as :dice be [6, 5, 5, 3]
  let streamDistinct be [1, 2, 1, 3, 2][:select value => value][:distinct]
  let streamDistinctBy be units[:filter unit where unit.hp > 0][:distinct by unit => unit.faction]
  let diceStreamDistinctBy be dice[:filter value where true][:distinct by value => value]
  emit Done(streamLen: :len streamDistinct, streamFirst: streamDistinct[1], streamSecond: streamDistinct[2], streamThird: streamDistinct[3], byLen: :len streamDistinctBy, byFirst: streamDistinctBy[1].name, bySecond: streamDistinctBy[2].name, diceLen: :len diceStreamDistinctBy, diceFirst: diceStreamDistinctBy[1], diceSecond: diceStreamDistinctBy[2], diceThird: diceStreamDistinctBy[3])
}

tests.name: sort direct and stream source kinds
tests.script:
module AtomicSortKinds
on Start {
  let values be [3, 1, 2, 2]
  let dice as :dice be [6, 4, 2]
  let range as :range be from 3 to 1 step -1
  let map be [b: 2, a: 1]
  let streamSorted be [1, 2, 3][:select value => 0 - value][:sort ascending]
  let ascending be values[:sort ascending]
  let descending be values[:sort descending]
  let diceAscending be dice[:sort ascending]
  let diceDescending be dice[:sort descending]
  let rangeAscending be range[:sort ascending]
  let rangeDescending be range[:sort descending]
  emit Done(asc_1: ascending[1], asc_2: ascending[2], asc_3: ascending[3], asc_4: ascending[4], desc_1: descending[1], desc_2: descending[2], desc_3: descending[3], desc_4: descending[4], dice_1: diceAscending[1], dice_2: diceAscending[2], dice_3: diceAscending[3], diceAscIsList: diceAscending is :list, diceDesc_1: diceDescending[1], diceDesc_2: diceDescending[2], diceDesc_3: diceDescending[3], diceDescIsList: diceDescending is :list, range_1: rangeAscending[1], range_2: rangeAscending[2], range_3: rangeAscending[3], rangeAscIsRange: rangeAscending is :range, rangeDesc_1: rangeDescending[1], rangeDesc_2: rangeDescending[2], rangeDesc_3: rangeDescending[3], rangeDescIsRange: rangeDescending is :range, stream_1: streamSorted[1], stream_2: streamSorted[2], stream_3: streamSorted[3], nothingValue: missing[:sort ascending], integerValue: 10[:sort ascending], textValue: 'ba'[:sort ascending], tagValue: :ba[:sort ascending], mapValue: map[:sort ascending])
}

tests.name: order by source kinds
tests.script:
module AtomicOrderByKinds
on Start {
  let units be [[name: 'Knight', hp: 10], [name: 'Rook', hp: 8], [name: 'Archer', hp: 6]]
  let values be [1, 3, 2]
  let dice as :dice be [6, 5, 3]
  let range as :range be from 1 to 3
  let map be [b: 2, a: 1]
  let byHpAscending be units[:order by unit => unit.hp ascending]
  let byHpDescending be units[:order by unit => unit.hp descending]
  let valuesDescending be values[:order by value => value descending]
  let diceAscending be dice[:order by value => value ascending]
  let rangeDescending be range[:order by value => value descending]
  let streamOrdered be units[:filter unit where unit.hp > 0][:order by unit => unit.name ascending]
  emit Done(hpAsc_1: byHpAscending[1].name, hpAsc_2: byHpAscending[2].name, hpAsc_3: byHpAscending[3].name, hpDesc_1: byHpDescending[1].name, hpDesc_2: byHpDescending[2].name, hpDesc_3: byHpDescending[3].name, values_1: valuesDescending[1], values_2: valuesDescending[2], values_3: valuesDescending[3], dice_1: diceAscending[1], dice_2: diceAscending[2], dice_3: diceAscending[3], range_1: rangeDescending[1], range_2: rangeDescending[2], range_3: rangeDescending[3], stream_1: streamOrdered[1].name, stream_2: streamOrdered[2].name, stream_3: streamOrdered[3].name, nothingValue: missing[:order by value => value ascending], integerValue: 10[:order by value => value ascending], textValue: 'ba'[:order by value => value ascending], mapValue: map[:order by value => value ascending])
}

tests.name: group by source kinds
tests.script:
module AtomicGroupByKinds
on Start {
  let units be [[name: 'Knight', faction: :melee, hp: 10], [name: 'Rook', faction: :melee, hp: 8], [name: 'Archer', faction: :ranged, hp: 6]]
  let values be [1, 2, 3, 4]
  let dice as :dice be [6, 5, 5, 3]
  let range as :range be from 1 to 4
  let map be [b: 2, a: 1, c: 2]
  let unitGroups be units[:group by unit => unit.faction]
  let parityGroups be values[:group by value => value mod 2]
  let diceGroups be dice[:group by value => value]
  let rangeGroups be range[:group by value => value mod 2]
  let mapGroups be map[:group by value => value]
  let textGroups be 'aba'[:group by value => value]
  let emptyGroups be 10[:group by value => value]
  emit Done(meleeLen: :len unitGroups[:melee], meleeFirst: unitGroups[:melee][1].name, meleeSecond: unitGroups[:melee][2].name, rangedLen: :len unitGroups[:ranged], rangedFirst: unitGroups[:ranged][1].name, oddLen: :len parityGroups['1'], oddFirst: parityGroups['1'][1], evenLen: :len parityGroups['0'], evenFirst: parityGroups['0'][1], diceFiveLen: :len diceGroups['5'], diceSixFirst: diceGroups['6'][1], rangeEvenLen: :len rangeGroups['0'], mapTwoLen: :len mapGroups['2'], textALen: :len textGroups['a'], emptyLen: :len emptyGroups)
}
